title: Tapenade Crostini
description: A simple appetizer or snack recipe featuring a rich and savory tapenade spread on toasted baguette slices.
instructions: Slice the baguette into 1/2-inch thick rounds.
Place the baguette slices on a baking sheet and drizzle with olive oil.
Toast the bread in the oven for 5-7 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Spread 1 tablespoon of tapenade on each toasted baguette slice.
Top with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
If using, drizzle with a small amount of Nutella for a chocolate twist.
